item.title: 神经网络原子间势的集成式不确定性量化方法比较研究
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yonatan Kurniawan (Department of Physics and Astronomy, Brigham Young University, Provo, Utah, USA), Mingjian Wen (Institute of Fundamental and Frontier Sciences, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Chengdu, China), Ellad B. Tadmor (Department of Aerospace Engineering and Mechanics, University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA), Mark K. Transtrum (Cross Stream Consulting, Springville, UT, USA)
该研究系统比较了用于神经网络机器学习原子间势的多种集成式不确定性量化方法，包括 bootstrap、dropout、随机初始化和快照集成。作者关注预测精度与实际准确性之间的关系，特别是在分布内与分布外情形以及系统级性质预测中的可靠性。工作指出，仅在小规模从头算能量和力数据上验证模型并不足以保证复杂材料模拟中的涌现行为可靠，因此需要更深入评估不确定性指标作为准确性代理的适用范围。

item.title: 利用多模态机器学习与自驱动显微术加速结构—性质关系发现
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiawei Gong, Danqing Ma, Ralph Bulanadi, Robert Moore, Rama Vasudevan, Lianfeng Zhao, Yongtao Liu
该工作提出一种结合自主显微测量、双新颖性深核学习和双变分自编码器的框架，用于自适应采集并表征材料的纳米尺度结构—性质关系。深核学习模块引导显微镜优先探索结构和谱学上新颖的区域，而双 VAE 将局域结构与谱响应嵌入共享潜在空间，形成结构—性质映射。作者将该方法用于卤化物钙钛矿薄膜的导电原子力显微研究，揭示了与晶界交汇点等纳米结构特征相关的不同迟滞行为。

item.title: 机器学习势的对比正则化
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dimitrios Tzivrailis, Georgios Sotiropoulos, Alberto Rosso, Eiji Kawasaki
该文指出，机器学习原子间势虽然通常以能量和力的均方误差训练，但其实际用途是作为分子模拟采样器，因此逐点预测准确并不保证生成正确的平衡分布。作者展示了标准 MSE 训练的势即使在测试集上达到化学精度，也可能在动力学中漂移到虚假的低能极小值，导致热力学观测量严重偏离参考结果。为此，文章提出对比正则化 MSE 后训练方法，利用势函数自身定义的玻尔兹曼分布与目标分布之间的 KL 散度构造对比项，通过持久 Langevin 链发现并抬高模型偏好的异常构型，而无需新增从头算数据。

item.title: ElemeNet: Multiscale Molecular Machine Learning with Uncertainty Quantification Across the Periodic Table
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jacob W. Toney, Samir Darouich, Yiran Wang, Aaron G. Garrison, Johannes Kästner, Heather J. Kulik
arXiv:2606.30961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advances in deep learning architectures and representations have enabled ML-driven chemical property prediction, but state-of-the-art (SOTA) models have remained largely confined to independent codebases and lack support for diverse chemical species. This work introduces ElemeNet, a unified, general-purpose software package for molecular machine learning. The ElemeNet software package enables the training of advanced ML models for diverse properties and datasets with an enlarged range of elemental compositions. We define molecular representations compatible with elements 1-100, supporting diverse organometallic and biological systems in addition to organic chemistry already well-served by the Chemprop ML toolkit. item.title: The HydroGym Reinforcement Learning Platform for Fluid Dynamics
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Christian Lagemann, Sajeda Mokbel, Miro Gondrum, Mario Rüttgers, Yuning Wang, Pol Suárez, Ludger Paehler, Deniz A. Bezgin, Aaron B. Buhendwa, Jared L. Callaham, Samuel Ahnert, Nicholas Zolman, Xiao Shao, Jean-Christophe Loiseau, Nikolaus Adams, Matthias Meinke, Wolfgang Schröder, Kai Lagemann, Esther Lagemann, Ricardo Vinuesa, Steven L. Brunton
arXiv:2512.17534v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modeling and controlling fluids is critical across science and engineering. Effective flow control can increase lift, reduce drag, enhance mixing, and attenuate noise, potentially unlocking new technologies. Yet controlling fluids is hard: the dynamics are high-dimensional, nonlinear, and multiscale. While reinforcement learning (RL) has recently succeeded in robotics and protein folding through shared benchmarks, fluid dynamics has resisted such progress: each controller is typically tuned to a single geometry and operating point, making results hard to accumulate, transfer, and compare. We introduce HydroGym, a solver-independent RL platform for flow control, and show that standardized infrastructure unlocks transferable control intell…

item.title: Beyond the Expressivity-Trainability Paradox: A Dynamical Lie Algebra Perspective on Navigating Barren Plateaus in Quantum Machine Learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kung-Ming Lan, Edward Huang
arXiv:2606.31536v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: As Quantum Machine Learning (QML) transitions toward practical implementation, the field faces a critical architectural bottleneck that challenges the fundamental assumptions of classical statistical learning theory. In classical deep learning, increasing model capacity typically risks overfitting. However, this study advances a counter-intuitive paradigm: unstructured contemporary QML architectures suffer from a profound state of quantum underfitting, driven by the "expressivity-trainability paradox." We demonstrate that the vast Hilbert space capacity of Parameterized Quantum Circuits (PQCs)-traditionally chased as the source of quantum advantage is the direct mathematical cause of Barren Plateaus (BPs), where gradient landscapes become ex…

item.title: Pauli Weight Hamiltonian Term Selection for Optimized Machine Learning Based Quantum Error Mitigation
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fadhil Fatih Shiddiq, Darell Timothy Tarigan, Hadyan Luthfan Prihadi, Jusak S. Kosasih, Yanoar P. Sarwono, Leong-Chuan Kwek, Freddy Permana Zen
arXiv:2606.31195v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning provides a scalable solution for quantum error mitigation. However, the selection of appropriate Pauli strings for inclusion in training data remains a challenge. Current methods rely on heuristic or uniform random sampling, requiring data for every Pauli string in the Hamiltonian, a process that scales linearly with measurements and grows with system size. To address this, we introduce quantum error mitigation with prior knowledge of Pauli weights (Pauli weight quantum error mitigation (Pi-QEM)), a systematic framework that selects training observables based on Pauli weight. By leveraging the relationship between variance and locality in parameterized quantum circuits, Pi-QEM trains on a small subset of dominant, low-weig…

item.title: ReactionAtlas: Ab origine exploration of chemical reaction networks with machine learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Stefan Gugler, Max Eissler, Khaled Kahouli, Klaus-Robert Müller
arXiv:2606.30778v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mapping a chemical reaction network, the graph of minima and transition states (TS) and the elementary reactions connecting them, is the natural language of chemistry, from catalysis to combustion to the origin of life. Constructing such a reaction network for a given chemistry has been impractical: it requires finding and characterizing tens of thousands of TS, a task for which traditional methods such as density functional theory (DFT) are typically prohibitively slow and require reactant and product as input. We introduce ReactionAtlas, which builds a reaction network ab origine from a handful of seed molecules and without hand-crafted rules. Specifically, our machine-learned generative model proposes reactions from kinetically sampled…

item.title: Deep neural networks as discrete dynamical systems: Implications for physics-informed learning
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
We revisit the analogy between feed-forward deep neural networks (DNNs) and discrete dynamical systems derived from neural integral equations and their corresponding partial differential equation forms. A comparative analysis between the numerical/exact solutions of the Burgers’ and Eikonal equations and those obtained via physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) is presented. We show that PINN learning provides a different computational pathway compared to standard numerical discretization in approximating essentially the same underlying dynamics of the system. Within this framework, DNNs can be interpreted as discrete dynamical systems whose layerwise evolution approaches attractors, and multiple parameter configurations may yield comparable solutions, reflecting the degeneracy of the i…

item.title: Temperature Field Reconstruction of Tungsten Monoblock Divertor on EAST using Physics-aware Neural Operator Transformer
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zikang Yan, Xiao Wang, Qingquan Yang, Zhendong Yang, Gaoting Chen, Zehua Chen, Bo Jiang, Jin Tang, Guosheng Xu
arXiv:2606.31574v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate modeling of the divertor temperature field is essential for preventing material melting and damage and for extending the service life of fusion devices. However, conventional numerical methods, such as the Finite Element Method (FEM), are computationally expensive and therefore unsuitable for real-time applications. Therefore, a fast and generalizable method is required for real-time reconstruction of the divertor temperature field and subsequent real-time control. To address the above issue, we propose a Physics-aware Neural Operator Transformer (PNOT) to characterize the spatiotemporal evolution of the divertor temperature field. It models boundary heat-flux relations as a structured graph and employs graph attention to explicit…

item.title: 基于主动学习的替代模型用于 LPBF Hastelloy-X 疲劳寿命预测：结合缺陷信息的有限元分析
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Chandrashekhar Pilgar, G Gangaraju
该研究提出一种结合缺陷信息的混合框架，将有限元分析与高斯过程主动学习相结合，用于预测激光粉末床熔融 Hastelloy-X 在不同应变幅、温度、成形方向和缺陷条件下的应变控制疲劳寿命。作者提出统一的缺陷敏感应变—寿命模型，仅用19个数据点校准即取得较高预测精度，并在440点数据集上优于传统模型。缺陷信息有限元分析揭示了不同缺陷引起的应力集中层级，并表明表面粗糙度与孔隙率的相互作用呈次加和特征。

item.title: 隐藏相纤锌矿 MnSe 单层中的完全补偿亚铁磁三铁性与多态输运
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zhuang Ma, Hongfei Liang, Po Ma, Guangqian Ding, Xuehao Wu, Sikander Azam, Guoying Gao, Long Zhang
该文预测了一种源自纤锌矿 (001) 面的隐藏相 MnSe 单层，其为本征二维完全补偿亚铁磁体，具有不由对称性关联的非等价子晶格。该材料同时表现出单极磁性半导体特征、垂直磁各向异性、铁电性和铁弹性，构成单相三铁性体系，并在一定应变范围内保持稳健。作者还提出 In2Se3/MnSe 异质结构可实现半导体态与金属态之间的非易失电控切换，相关隧道结显示出巨大的隧穿磁阻和电阻调控潜力。

item.title: 表面交替磁体 AV₂X₂O 家族中的非常规超导性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 M. Franz
受层状氧硫族化物 Na₂₋ₓV₂Se₂O 中发现16.3 K超导性的启发，该文研究由 V₂O 平面构成的更广泛层状材料家族中的配对不稳定性，这些材料的单层形式被认为具有交替磁序。尽管 KV₂Se₂O 和 Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O 等体相成员可能是常规反铁磁体且仅表现出表面交替磁性，分析仍预言等自旋三重态超导是这些材料中的主导配对不稳定性。该结果源于其独特磁性与子晶格结构使电子能带不适合常规自旋单态配对；预言的三重态超导相具有非平庸拓扑性质，并可能支持自旋极化持久电流。

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zeev Vager (Weizmann Institute of Science, Rehovot, Israel)
arXiv:2606.30670v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large spin polarization observed in chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) remains difficult to explain quantitatively. Experimental polarizations measured in chiral molecular systems are often substantially larger than expected from weak microscopic spin-orbit interaction in organic materials. We revisit the geometrical spin current introduced previously for electrons constrained to curved paths and propose a scale argument relevant to transport through double-stranded DNA (dsDNA). Estimation of the intrinsic geometrical spin-current scale using representative dsDNA parameters yields current magnitudes substantially larger than measured transport currents in many CISS experiments. We suggest that this hierarchy allows transport to be inte…

item.title: 奇波磁体中的磁性布洛赫振荡与非线性埃德尔斯坦效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jonas Habel, Johannes Knolle
该文研究电场作用下奇波磁体中磁化强度的非平衡动力学，提出“磁性布洛赫振荡”概念：磁化强度可在弛豫到稳态埃德尔斯坦值之前发生布洛赫振荡。作者通过解析与数值方法在一维 p 波磁体最小模型中展示该效应，并推广至二维情形。研究还表明埃德尔斯坦磁化通常对外加电场呈非线性响应，并提出可通过太赫兹亚周期光波谱中的高次谐波产生进行实验探测。

item.title: 线偏振脉冲诱导的超快磁化广泛存在于非磁性半导体中
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xiangzhou Zhu, Junfeng Qiao, Nicola Marzari, Matteo Calandra
该工作通过高通量第一性原理筛选实验已知无机晶体数据库，寻找可被线偏振飞秒脉冲光激发诱导自旋极化的非磁性半导体。作者识别出近 440 种候选材料，并将该现象归因于光诱导的交换驱动不稳定性。研究还分析了晶体场环境和带边轨道特征如何影响光诱导磁态的强度与类型，为材料筛选提供了化学和周期趋势指导。

item.title: 对称性强制的二维交替磁性铁电开关
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiangyu Zhao, Yibo Liu, Guoli Wu, Xinru Li, Ying Dai, Baibiao Huang, Yandong Ma
本文提出一种层工程策略，通过将常规反铁磁单层夹在两个相同铁电层之间，实现二维交替磁性的铁电可逆调控。面外铁电极化打破空间对称性并诱导稳健的交替磁自旋劈裂，而反转铁电极化会在整体宇称-时间组合对称性约束下精确反转自旋劈裂图样。第一性原理对 In₂Se₃/MnPTe₃/In₂Se₃ 三层结构的验证表明，该机制可导致反常霍尔信号的确定性翻转。

item.title: 石墨烯莫尔异质结构中可调的扩展磁性非费米液体
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yongqin Xie, Jian Wang, Moyu Chen, Chen Zhao, Fanqiang Chen, Qiao Li, Sicheng Chen, Jiao Xie, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Jin-hua Gao, Rui Wang, Shi-Jun Liang, Chunming Yin, Bin Cheng, Feng Miao
该研究报道了在对齐 hBN 封装的扭转双双层石墨烯中观察到可调的扩展非费米液体行为。该非费米液体相覆盖较宽的载流子密度范围，并表现出随载流子密度变化的电阻温度指数。结合温度依赖电阻、磁输运和微分电阻测量，作者认为该体系为研究准粒子与主导量子涨落耦合关系提供了高度可调平台。

item.title: 一维易轴 XXZ 铁磁体解禁闭转变点附近低温 kink 与 magnon 的竞争
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 P. N. Bibikov
本文研究一维易轴 XXZ 铁磁体在解禁闭转变点附近的有序相与量子超临界低温区域，并根据最低能主导激发给出物理解释。作者指出两个有序相主要由磁振子控制，而量子超临界区域则由 kink 激发主导。在这一框架下，论文还对 Ising 模型情形进行了较详细讨论。

item.title: 通过长程阻挫突破微磁学对斯格明子稳定性的限制
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shiwei Zhu, Moritz A. Goerzen, Changsheng Song, Dongzhe Li
该研究挑战了微磁学模型中斯格明子稳定性通常随尺寸或交换刚度变化的观点。作者将连续模型映射到自旋晶格哈密顿量，发现即便微磁参数相同，不同原子尺度交换相互作用也可导致显著不同的塌缩能垒。研究将这一现象归因于鞍点纹理的强非共线性，并提出长程交换阻挫优化框架，表明在现实条件下可显著提升纳米斯格明子的能垒稳定性。

item.title: 三维 h 波与 j 波奇宇称磁体中的四阶和六阶非线性自旋电流整流器
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Motohiko Ezawa
该文系统构造三维高阶 X 波磁体，并通过维度扩展方法从二维节点结构推广到三维，进而预言三维 j 波磁体。作者讨论了如何实验识别不同类型的 X 波磁体，强调非线性自旋电流可作为完整表征手段。研究预言三维 h 波奇宇称磁体仅出现四阶自旋电流，而三维 j 波奇宇称磁体仅出现六阶自旋电流；这些响应可实现与外加电场方向无关的单向自旋流整流。

item.title: 利用动态磁性对分布函数分析研究局域磁振子模式
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shin-ichi Shamoto, Yukio Yasui, Kazuki Iida, Yasuhiro Inamura, Motoyuki Ishikado, Mitsutaka Nakamura, Lieh-Jeng Chang
该工作提出并研究动态磁性对分布函数 DymPDF，它由非偏振非弹性中子散射测得的动态磁结构因子经傅里叶变换得到。作者针对简单磁模型及 FeTiO₃、YBa₂Cu₃O₆ 等代表性材料，推导低能极限下的表达式并与模拟比较。该方法揭示了实空间纳米尺度中局域磁振子模式的能量依赖特征，包括声学到光学磁振子模式的转变以及特定能量下自旋对关联的符号变化。

item.title: PT 对称反铁磁体中由量子度量诱导的广义磁光效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yongpan Li, Yichen Liu, Cheng-Cheng Liu
该研究提出由量子度量即量子几何实部诱导的广义磁光效应，以突破传统磁光效应主要源于贝里曲率的理解框架。作者建立了适用于三维和二维 PT 对称反铁磁体的 Kerr 角与 Faraday 角通用公式，并结合紧束缚模型和第一性原理计算进行了验证。该理论解释了零净磁矩 PT 对称反铁磁体中仍可观测到 Kerr 转角的微观来源，为探测反铁磁相变提供了新的磁光机制。

item.title: d 电子 Kagome 系统中倾斜反铁磁有序引发的拓扑霍尔响应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Waquar Ahmed, Steffen Schaeffer, Pierre Lombardo, Roland Hayn, Imam Makhfudz
该研究分析二维 Kagome 单层中 d 电子与非共线自旋有序相互作用所产生的非平庸本征贝里曲率。即使没有外磁场、显式自旋轨道耦合或相对论效应，底层反铁磁交换诱导的自旋结构也可导致量子反常霍尔效应。对于具有面外分量的倾斜自旋构型，有限标量自旋手征性可使布里渊区积分得到量子化霍尔电导；在理想情形下，非平庸能隙内的费米能级可对应最大 Chern 数 C=±5。作者还讨论了候选材料及实际材料中各向异性跃迁导致较小 Chern 数的可能性。

item.title: DC spin current driven by low-frequency light in altermagnets
item.description:
📚 Phys. Rev. B
